transcript: Speaker A: English mein ING ke agar ye rules aapne seekh liye, toh phir kabhi spelling mistakes nahi karoge... [If you learn these spelling rules for adding -ing in English, you will never make spelling mistakes again. Adding -ing to 'jump' makes 'jumping', but for 'run' it becomes 'running' with a double 'n'. Ever wondered why? Let me explain a simple rule. Count letters from the end. If the second letter is a short vowel, double the last letter before adding -ing. Thus, 'run' becomes 'running' and 'tap' becomes 'tapping'. But for 'jump', the vowel is the third letter from the end, so we don't double it. Thus, 'jump' becomes 'jumping' and 'help' becomes 'helping'. You can learn thousands of such shortcuts and daily English on the English Seekho app without rote learning. Watch short, crisp videos by experts to master grammar and pronunciation. The best feature is the AI coach, allowing you to practice speaking English day and night without hesitation or fear of judgment. It corrects your mistakes and polishes your English. Stop memorizing rules; download the English Seekho app now.]
